directions.title: Physics-Enhanced AI for Transportation
directions.description: This research develops interpretable, physically consistent, and robust AI methods for transportation systems, with applications in multimodal reasoning, prediction, decision-making, and control.

projects.title: A Low-Rank Method for Vision Language Model Hallucination Mitigation in Autonomous Driving
projects.alt: Low-rank vision-language model hallucination mitigation framework
projects.summary: A low-rank approach to mitigating vision-language model hallucinations in autonomous driving.

projects.title: VLM-MPC: Model Predictive Controller Augmented Vision Language Model for Autonomous Driving
projects.summary: Connecting vision-language reasoning with model predictive control for autonomous driving.

projects.title: Physical Enhanced Residual Learning (PERL) Framework for Vehicle Trajectory Prediction
projects.alt: Physics-enhanced residual learning framework for vehicle trajectory prediction
projects.summary: Combining physical knowledge and residual learning for vehicle trajectory prediction.

projects.title: Physics Enhanced Residual Policy Learning for Safety Cruising of Autonomous Vehicles
projects.summary: Combining physics and residual policy learning for the safety cruising of autonomous vehicles.

projects.title: Physics-informed Neural Network for Cross-dynamics Vehicle Trajectory Stitching
projects.alt: Physics-informed neural network for cross-dynamics trajectory stitching
projects.summary: Using physics-informed neural networks to stitch vehicle trajectories across different dynamics.

directions.question: How can physical knowledge make transportation AI more reliable?
directions.intro: This direction connects physical models with learning, prediction, reasoning, and control. The selected work spans residual learning, physics-informed neural networks, and vision-language models.

directions.title: Connected and Automated Vehicles
directions.description: This research evaluates and improves the safety and performance of connected and automated vehicles in challenging scenarios, including extreme weather, long-tail events, and interactions with vulnerable road users.

projects.title: CATS-V2V: A Real-World Vehicle-to-Vehicle Cooperative Perception Dataset with Complex Adverse Traffic Scenarios
projects.summary: Real-world vehicle-to-vehicle observations for studying cooperative perception in complex, adverse traffic scenarios.

projects.title: Traffic Oscillation Mitigation with Physics-Enhanced Residual Learning-Based Predictive Control
projects.alt: Field experiment and predictive control framework for traffic oscillation mitigation
projects.summary: Physics-enhanced residual learning and predictive control for mitigating traffic oscillations, with field-experiment evidence.

projects.title: Before and After Riding: Changing Comfort Attitude Towards Autonomous Shuttles from Perspectives as Riders, Drivers, and Pedestrians
projects.alt: Autonomous shuttle operated in Dunedin, Florida
projects.summary: Studying how riding an autonomous shuttle changes comfort attitudes from the perspectives of riders, drivers, and pedestrians.

directions.question: How do automated vehicles perform in challenging real-world conditions?
directions.intro: This direction brings together cooperative perception, vehicle control, field experiments, and human responses to automated vehicles.

directions.title: Intelligent Transportation Systems
directions.description: This research studies how people, vehicles, and transportation infrastructure can be connected and coordinated to improve safety and efficiency.

projects.title: Park Street Aerial Vehicle Trajectory Dataset
projects.alt: Park Street aerial vehicle trajectory dataset
projects.summary: Aerial vehicle trajectory observations along Park Street for studying traffic behavior and corridor operations.

projects.title: Aerial-View Vehicle Detection Dataset
projects.summary: A drone-view vehicle image dataset for transportation sensing and vehicle detection.

projects.title: AI-Enabled Digital Twin Framework for Safe and Sustainable Intelligent Transportation
projects.summary: An AI-enabled digital twin framework for safe and sustainable intelligent transportation.

directions.question: How can sensing and digital models improve transportation systems?
directions.intro: This direction connects aerial traffic observations, vehicle trajectory data, and digital twins to study interactions among people, vehicles, and infrastructure.
